invariants.rationale: Method returns a value so result is expected to be non-null under normal operation.
Argument preppedRecords is expected to be non-null to perform upsert.
instantTime is usually a required identifier, expected to be non-null and non-empty.
A valid HoodieEngineContext is likely required for upsert operations.
HoodieWriteMetadata is expected to provide write statuses in its result.
